interpolation_check.method: Linear distance-to-z interpolation checked at every interval midpoint
interpolation_check.scope: Deterministic grid check, not a global rigorous error bound or observational uncertainty

limitations: Fixed parameter explanation, not full AstropyPlanck18: radiation and massive-neutrino evolution are omitted.

Source-observer separation is treated as a simultaneous present-epoch comoving Euclidean distance. Nearby public distances are not established comoving distances and require this explicit experiment assumption.

A displaced comoving observer would receive different photons at a different source emission time; real source evolution, worldline, travel time, peculiar motions and bound-system cosmological expansion are not reconstructed.
Distances beyond z20model range are rejected; no artificial clamping or fabricated redshift.
cosmology.tcmb_setting_role: Tcmb0=0 is a computational switch disabling radiation in this simplified matter+Lambda calculation; it is not an observed or assumed physical CMB temperature of0K.

camera_interpretation.status: User-authorized hypothetical observer experiment, not a measured observer trajectory

limitations: Fixed measured sourcez remains immutable and distinct from residual-distance FLRWmodelz. Never treat their product as independent cosmological factors.
Extra radial Doppler and static gravitational factors are explicitly selected incremental experiments; an observed z may already include such effects and is not decomposed here.
All shift factors mean received/emitted wavelength, not frequency. No arbitrary RGB color spectrum, intrinsic source spectral energy distribution or calibrated image photometry is inferred.

No all-physics claim: Kerr spin, ray-transfer radiative hydrodynamics, full Einstein-equation evolution, interiors, observer acceleration/worldlines, relativistic aberration and time-dependent cosmology are outside this bounded experiment.

provider_policy.excluded_new_distribution_providers: Chinese agencies and Chinese data archives are not allowlisted
provider_policy.verification_scope: Selected immediate data/metadata distribution providers and explicitly identified mission agencies; not a guarantee about every historical upstream telescope or author institution
provider_policy.confirmed_prohibited_original_data_polic: Withhold affected runtime value as null with reason; retain reviewed source bytes locally for audit
